visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bright, modern office with white desks. A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white and blue top, is seated in a black office chair, stretching her arms above her head. A man in a white T-shirt and light blue jeans enters from the right, gesturing toward her while speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face and active hand movements. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the back of a human leg (popliteal area). A finger points to a specific spot marked with a red digital dot. (3) A pink and silver hair dryer is introduced. The man crouches down, using the hair dryer to blow air onto the woman's leg while she stands. (4) The man stands again, gesturing energetically. Fast-paced cuts show brief inset images: one of an actor (Chow Yun-fat) eating chocolate and another of a man (Jensen Huang) in a leather jacket. (5) The man transitions to sitting in a high-end black mesh ergonomic chair (SIDIZ T50 AIR). He demonstrates the chair's comfort by leaning back and spreading his arms. (6) A series of rapid close-ups showcase the chair's details: the breathable mesh texture, the adjustable armrests, the S-shaped lumbar support, and the headrest. The woman is seen working at a computer in the chair, later turning to give two thumbs up. (7) The man sits back in the chair, demonstrating the five-stage tilt mechanism with overlaid geometric lines. He concludes by standing next to the chair against a white background, pointing to promotional text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic dance track with a prominent beat and bright synth melodies. A male voice speaks rapidly and clearly with a friendly yet authoritative tone, introducing the topic of back pain. (2) A clear 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of a secret tip. The background music remains steady. (3) The rhythmic whirring of a hair dryer is heard as the man explains a health tip. His voice remains clear over the mechanical sound, modulated for instructional emphasis. (4) Multiple sharp 'whoosh' transitions and cartoon-style 'pop' effects coincide with visual changes and image inserts. The music continues without pause. (5) A heavy 'thud' or impact sound effect plays as the man sits in the chair. His voice becomes more promotional and persuasive. (6) Soft mechanical 'click' and 'sliding' sound effects are audible, mimicking the physical adjustment of chair parts. A female voice briefly interjects with a high-pitched, positive exclamation. (7) The music reaches its highest intensity as the man provides detailed technical information about the chair, concluding with a final stinger sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Solution -> Product Reveal -> Features -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the SIDIZ T50 AIR ergonomic chair by first addressing common back pain issues, offering a simple DIY health tip as a hook, and then positioning the chair as the ultimate long-term solution for office comfort.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a direct product reveal, detailed feature walkthrough, brand logos, and a clear call to action regarding a specific sale.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media format with fast editing, bright visuals, and variety-show style text to maintain viewer engagement for an advertisement.
